voice note / interaction

Motion·by @proskuaaa·2026-08-27·inspora page·original post

What it is

Mobile voice-note recorder: from a shared-list app ('Sunday Brunch Prep'), tapping the mic opens a dark bottom-sheet recorder; a vertical blue playhead line bounces with input level, a timer counts up, and a live waveform crystallizes behind the playhead as recording continues; stop/skip/delete controls; sheet dismisses back to the list.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-12%
List view (recipe cards, checklist); action sheet slides up with 6 icon options (scan, photo, voice, etc.) - voice picked.
12-25%
Dark recorder sheet rises over dimmed list: black card, single vertical blue line at rest, '00:00' timer, avatar chip.
25-60%
Recording: timer counts 00:01->00:03; white waveform bars materialize behind the playhead leftward as audio accumulates; playhead line height pulses with input level.
60-85%
Waveform grows denser; controls at bottom (stop square, skip-forward, trash) stay static; 'New Audio from you' caption.
85-100%
Sheet slides down, list view restored.

Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: a mobile voice-note recorder inside a shared-list app ("Sunday Brunch Prep"). Tapping the mic opens a dark bottom-sheet recorder: a vertical blue playhead line bounces with input level, a timer counts up, and a live waveform crystallizes behind the playhead as recording continues. Stop / skip / delete controls; the sheet dismisses back to the list.

## Stack
React + TypeScript + Tailwind + Framer Motion (sheet spring; waveform bars appended on an interval or from mic input). Animate transform and opacity only.

## Scene
List view (recipe cards, checklist). Action sheet slides up with 6 icon options (scan, photo, voice...). Voice picked: dark recorder sheet - black card, single vertical blue line at rest, "00:00" mono timer, avatar chip, caption "New Audio from you", bottom controls (stop square, skip-forward, trash).

## Motion spec
Pattern: sheet presentation + live input-driven waveform.
- Action sheet: rises 350ms spring (damping ~26) over a dimmed backdrop (black/40, 250ms).
- Recorder sheet: same spring up; list stays dimmed behind.
- Recording: timer counts up (mono, tabular-nums, 1s cadence); playhead line height pulses per audio frame with input level; white waveform bars materialize behind the playhead (~10 bars/s), each fading in 100ms.
- Controls static throughout. Stop or dismiss: sheet slides down 300ms, list restores.

## Calibration
- Sheet spring damping ~26: one soft settle, no bounce festival.
- Playhead pulse must track the input frame-by-frame - a metronome pulse reads as fake.
- Waveform bars append behind (leftward of) the playhead; the playhead is always the right edge.

## Reduced motion
Sheet fades in/out (200ms); playhead shows a steady line; waveform bars appear without stagger.

## Don't miss
- Two distinct sheets (action sheet, then recorder) - do not merge them into one step.
- The blue playhead is a single vertical line, not a moving bar graph.
- Timer uses tabular-nums so it never jitters sideways while counting.
